operation.description: plan hashes the staged baseline/candidate scripts without running them; run executes exactly that plan.

benchmark.description: Operator-staged folder perf-lab-v1/<benchmark> in the plugin's own data home, holding baseline.js and candidate.js.

samples.description: Measured samples per side; fewer than 10 is always reported inconclusive.

minEffectPercent.description: Slowdown that counts as a regression.

sampleTimeoutMs.description: Per-call limit; (samples+warmup)×2×limit must not exceed 20000 ms.

planSha.description: Required for run: planSha returned by plan. Any staged byte change invalidates it.
